intro_html: A hearty, saucy ragu that tastes like it simmered all day but comes together in one skillet. At about $4.87 a serving (at everyday cost) with 52 grams of protein, it is a comforting one. It makes 14 servings, so cook once and eat all week.
cost_closing_html: About $4.87 a bowl (at everyday cost) for a high-protein dinner that beats takeout on price and macros.
portion_html: Each of the 14 servings delivers 52 grams of protein and about 604 calories.
upsell_html: Comforting, filling, and easy on the wallet, this is a bowl of pasta you can feel good about. Members get every recipe in the Meal Prep section, plus the full library of money lessons and tools, all for $1 a month.
shop_smart: The 7 lb ground turkey pack is the smart buy and keeps this hearty dish easy on the budget.
Jarred marinara in the store brand saves a couple bucks a jar over the name brands and works great as your base.
Buy pasta by the box on sale and keep a couple in the pantry. It is the cheapest way to stretch a meal.
make_it: Cook the penne according to the box while you get the sauce going.
Heat a little olive oil in a large skillet and brown the ground turkey.
Add the chopped onion and shredded carrots and cook until they soften.
Pour in the marinara and let it simmer 15 minutes so it turns rich and thick.
Toss the cooked penne into the sauce and stir until every noodle is coated.
